choices.content: The line passes through both foci

question.prompt: If the quadratic equation obtained by substituting the equation of a line into the equation of an ellipse has 2 distinct real roots, what does this indicate?

solutions.explanation: Each real root gives a value of the coordinate remaining after substitution, and the line equation uniquely determines the other coordinate. Thus each root gives one intersection point, distinct roots give distinct points, and every intersection point must arise this way. Therefore, there are \(2\) intersection points, choice A.
solutions.title: Relate real roots to intersection points
